mapper.sql: SELECT qual_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, qual_name, qual_type, qual_code, issue_date, expire_date, status, file_url, file_name, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_supplier_qualification
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_supplier_qualification ( supplier_id, supplier_name, qual_name, qual_type, qual_code, issue_date, expire_date, status, file_url, file_name, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{qualName}, #{qualType}, #{qualCode}, #{issueDate}, #{expireDate}, #{status}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_supplier_qualification SET status = #{status}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE qual_id = #{qualId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_supplier_qualification SET del_flag = '2' WHERE qual_id IN #{qualId}
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '1' AND expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date < CURDATE()
